title: nicoaira/ginflow pipeline parameters
description: Nextflow pipeline for BLAST-style search over RNA secondary structures using GINFINITY embeddings and FAISS, ScaNN, NGT, cuVS, or quantized-node HNSWLIB seeding.

input.description: Structures table used to build the vector database. Required columns: transcript_id, sequence, secondary_structure. Optional start/end columns (0-based half-open; comma-separated lists for several windows) build one independent subject per window. Extra columns are allowed. Omit when searching an existing --database.

query.description: Structures table to search. Same columns as --input, including optional start/end windows. Each window is an independent query. Omit for a build-only run.

database.description: Existing window database from a previous run (windows.tsv, meta.json, and a vector index). Use with --query. Do not combine with --input.

outdir.description: Output directory for the reusable index, seeds, and optional graph, embedding, window, and quantized-window shards.

save_graphs.description: Publish per-shard graph tensors and metadata under graphs_shards/. Graphs are still created internally when needed by downstream stages.

save_embeddings.description: Publish per-shard residue embeddings and manifests under embeddings_shards/. Embeddings are still created internally when needed by downstream stages.

save_windows.description: Publish raw per-shard sliding-window vectors and manifests under windows_shards/. Windows are still created internally when needed by downstream stages.

save_quantized_windows.description: Publish intermediate quantized window shards under windows_quantized/. These shards are still created internally when required by a quantized index.

shard_size.description: Maximum number of input TSV rows per BUILD_RNA_GRAPHS job. A row with several start/end windows expands to several graphs inside that shard.

id_column.description: Column name for the molecule identifier.

sequence_column.description: Column name for the RNA sequence.

structure_column.description: Column name for the dot-bracket secondary structure.

start_column.description: Optional 0-based half-open window start column. Empty cell = full molecule. A comma-separated list (e.g. 34,40) pairs with --end_column to make several independent subjects from one row.

end_column.description: Optional 0-based half-open window end column. Must be present whenever --start_column is. Same number of comma-separated values as start.

no_slices.description: Ignore start/end columns and encode every row as a full molecule.

keep_paired_neighbours.description: For a start/end window, keep bases outside the core that are paired with a core nucleotide so they take part in message passing. Embeddings still contain only the core.

context_hops.description: How far to expand around crossing-pair partners when --keep_paired_neighbours is set. 1 = the partner only; higher values also take neighbouring nucleotides. Does not change embedding length.

delimiter.description: Field delimiter of the structures table.

embed_device.description: Embedding device: cpu or gpu. GPU tasks use the CUDA-backed GINFINITY environment and container; select an ordinary execution profile such as docker, singularity, apptainer, or conda. The legacy value cuda is deprecated and normalized to gpu.

window_size.description: Sliding-window length in nucleotides. Each window is the concatenation of this many 128-d residue vectors.

seed_k.description: Maximum neighbours kept per query window after optional exact rerank. Increase with database size (for example 50 for small sets, 200+ for millions of windows).

seed_min_similarity.description: Minimum cosine similarity (L2-normalized window inner product) required to keep a seed.

search_shard_size.description: Query records per index-search job. Defaults to --shard_size. Does not change database graph/embed shards. Ignored when --input and --query are the same file (search reuses the database shards).

candidate_k.description: Candidate pool retrieved from an approximate index before optional exact rerank to --seed_k. Must be >= --seed_k. Increase with database size (200 default; 1000 around 1M windows; 5000 around 4M+).

quantize.description: Node-level compression applied before index windows are formed. none keeps float windows; sq is scalar int8 with standard L2/IP; pq/opq product-quantize each 128-d node then form code windows. See docs/indexes.md.

pq_m.description: PQ/OPQ subquantizers per 128-d node. Must divide 128. Applies to --quantize pq|opq.

pq_nbits.description: Bits per PQ subquantizer. 4-bit M=16 is the recommended compact layout. Applies to --quantize pq|opq.

pq_sample_size.description: Maximum node vectors sampled to fit PQ/OPQ.

opq_iters.description: OPQ outer Procrustes iterations. Applies to --quantize opq.

hnswlib_m.description: HNSW graph degree for --index hnswlib (CPU PQ/OPQ path).

hnswlib_random_seed.description: Random seed for HNSWLIB graph construction.

hnswlib_num_threads.description: HNSWLIB worker threads. Zero uses the library default.

exact_rerank.description: Rerank ANN candidates with original-window inner product, then keep --seed_k seeds. Skipped automatically for exact FAISS FlatIP/FlatL2.

exact_rerank_device.description: Exact reranking device: cpu or gpu. CPU uses multiple workers; GPU uses CuPy batches and requires a GPU-capable execution environment. The legacy value cuda is deprecated and normalized to gpu.

exact_rerank_batch_size.description: Number of query windows processed per exact-reranking batch.

exact_rerank_candidate_batch_size.description: Candidate windows scored per sub-batch, bounding CPU RAM/GPU VRAM when candidate pools are large.

exact_rerank_workers.description: CPU exact-reranking workers. Zero uses the process CPU allocation; ignored on GPU.

index.description: Index used to build and search windows. faiss uses --faiss_index; cagra is cuVS CAGRA for none/sq and custom PQ-CAGRA for pq/opq; ivf is cuVS IVF-Flat; hnswlib is CPU custom-distance PQ/OPQ. See docs/indexes.md.

search_device.description: CAGRA search device: gpu or cpu. CPU uses a converted HNSW graph for uncompressed/SQ CAGRA (--cagra_to_hnsw) or the CPU ADC walker for PQ-CAGRA. GPU selection requires a GPU-capable execution environment. The legacy values auto and cuda are deprecated and normalized to gpu.

cagra_to_hnsw.description: After a GPU CAGRA build, convert the graph for CPU search. Uncompressed/SQ: cuVS CAGRA to HNSW. PQ/OPQ: CPU ADC search of the same serialized graph.

cagra_graph_degree.description: CAGRA retained graph degree. For PQ-CAGRA, 32 is a practical compact setting.

cagra_build_algo.description: cuVS CAGRA graph builder for uncompressed/SQ windows.

cagra_nndescent_iterations.description: NN-Descent iterations for PQ-CAGRA graph construction.

cagra_itopk_size.description: CAGRA intermediate search beam. Raised to at least --candidate_k at search time.

cuvs_n_lists.description: cuVS IVF-Flat coarse clusters. Applies to --index ivf.

cuvs_n_probes.description: cuVS IVF-Flat lists searched per query. Applies to --index ivf.

faiss_index.description: FAISS type for --index faiss. GPU (--faiss_device gpu) supports flatip and flatl2 only. ivfflat and hnsw are CPU-only; GPU IVF is --index ivf.

faiss_device.description: FAISS build and search device: cpu or gpu. GPU is supported for FlatIP and FlatL2 only and requires a GPU-capable execution environment. The legacy value cuda is deprecated and normalized to gpu.

faiss_gpu.description: Deprecated compatibility alias for --faiss_device gpu. When true, build and search FAISS FlatIP/FlatL2 on GPU. Not available for FAISS IVF or HNSW; GPU IVF is --index ivf.

faiss_nprobe.description: IVF lists visited at search time for --faiss_index ivfflat.

faiss_hnsw_m.description: FAISS HNSW graph neighbors (M). CPU only.

cluster_span.description: Maximum nucleotide gap, on query and target, between a seed and the current cluster box.

cluster_min_seeds.description: Minimum seeds required to keep a cluster.

cluster_diagonal_tolerance.description: Allowed diagonal drift (query_start - target_start) when adding a seed.

cluster_max_diagonal_span.description: Maximum diagonal breadth of a cluster. 0 disables the cap.

cluster_max_seed_rank.description: Ignore FAISS hits worse than this rank. 0 keeps every seed.

align_pad.description: Nucleotides of context added on each side of a cluster before GINFINITY-SW.

align_max_cells.description: Maximum DP cells (crop length product) allowed for one cluster.

align_max_alignments.description: Maximum number of disjoint local HSPs used when calibrating pair-level scores.

align_min_score.description: Minimum local HSP score retained for pair-level EVD calibration.

align_min_match_count.description: Minimum number of matched residue columns in an HSP retained for EVD calibration.

align_cpus.description: CPU threads for ALIGN_CLUSTERS and ESTIMATE_EVD. Each task loads residue embeddings once and aligns independent cluster crops concurrently.

evd_samples.description: Reverse-sequence null alignments used to fit Karlin–Altschul λ and K.

evd_max_length.description: Crop each null sequence to this length so EVD calibration stays O(L^2).

evd_seed.description: RNG seed for reverse-sequence null sampling.

plot_backend.description: Draw aligned regions with RNArtistCore 2Ds, a unified R4RNA alignment arc plot, both, or skip plotting.

plot_sw.description: Draw crop cosine and substitution-score matrices, with the Smith–Waterman traceback on the score plot.

plot_max_pairs.description: Maximum alignment pairs to plot per query. RNArtistCore writes query and target 2Ds; R4RNA writes one alignment arc plot; SW writes cosine and score matrices.

plot_highlight_colour.description: Colour of the aligned span, shared R4RNA pairs, matching bases, and the SW traceback. Default is nf-core green.

report_theme.description: Colour theme of report.html. Light (gray-100 page, white cards) is the default; pass dark for a gray-900 report. The page also has a theme toggle.
